result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: Customer receives a 30-day convenience-termination right, a refund of prepaid fees attributable to the post-termination period, and Vendor has no convenience-termination right during a term. However, allowing termination of the Agreement or an Order Form “in whole or in part” goes beyond the stated playbook requirement and is ambiguous as to whether Customer may selectively terminate contractual obligations or service components, potentially disrupting unrelated pricing and scope arrangements. Deleting “in whole or in part” would make the revision more targeted and precise.
